note: Rewritten from Roonwal and Maiti (1966), "Termites from Indonesia including West Irian" (Treubia 27(1): 63–140), species entry 13 (pp. 93–97); the original is in English and is the original description (n. sp.), with soldiers and workers only, the alate recorded as "Unknown". The measurement tables (Tables 4, 5), figure numbers, material lists, geographical distribution and Remarks of the original are not entered item by item; the measurement figures are taken from the text and tables. Doubtful OCR readings (e.g. "segment 9-18", "0.80-0.35") have been interpreted against the context and the tables; figures that could not be adopted are not entered.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head pale cream-yellow, labrum and pronotum paler, mandibles dark brown, antennae, legs and abdominal tergites yellowish white, pilosity very sparse; body length including mandibles 4.5—5.2 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, about 1.5 times as long as wide; antennae 13-segmented, segment 1 cylindrical and the longest, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3 and nearly equal in length to segment 4; mandibles sabre-shaped, almost 1.5 times as long as the head (to the lateral mandible base). Worker head subquadrate, almost as long as wide (length to lateral mandible base 1.00 mm, maximum width 0.98 mm), antennae 13-segmented, segment 3 the shortest. Alate unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale cream-yellow, labrum and pronotum paler; mandibles dark brown; antennae, legs and abdominal tergites yellowish white. Pilosity very sparse. Body length including mandibles 4.5—5.2 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, almost 1.5 times as long as wide (length without mandibles 1.45—1.55 mm, maximum width 0.90—0.97 mm); sides nearly parallel, widest near the antennal bases; posterior margin very weakly convex; a few setae on the vertex and sides. Fontanelle indistinct; compound eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae 13-segmented, the basal segments sparsely hairy, the rest more densely so; segment 1 cylindrical and the longest, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3 and nearly equal in length to segment 4, segments 5—8 subequal in length, segments 9—13 gradually lengthening. Labrum subquadrate, slightly wider than long (maximum width 0.27—0.30 mm, maximum length 0.22—0.25 mm); apex broadly rounded, sides convex, labral face with 2 pairs of setae. Mandibles sabre-shaped, long and slender, strongly incurved apically, almost 1.5 times the head length (to the lateral mandible base) (head length 1.45—1.55 mm, mandible length 0.96—1.13 mm); inner margin finely serrate, outer margin strongly convex. Postmentum elongate, shorter than the head; widest at 2/3 of its length from the base, slightly narrowed anteriorly; posterior part constricted into a waist and then widening again; anterior margin weakly convex with a few hairs, posterior margin concave and slightly raised in the middle. Pronotum moderately saddle-shaped, much narrower than the head capsule, wider than long (width 0.58—0.65 mm, length 0.33—0.37 mm); fairly hairy; anterolateral corners narrowly rounded; sides narrowed posteriorly; anterior margin convex with a weak median notch; posterior margin convex, slightly incurved in the middle. Legs short, hairy, tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen long, hairy; cerci short, 2-segmented; styli short, 1-segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head, postclypeus and labrum yellowish white; anteclypeus and antennae paler; mandibles brownish yellow, the toothed edges dark brown; thorax pale yellowish white; the rest of the body white. Head and body sparsely hairy. Head subquadrate, broadly rounded posteriorly; sides nearly parallel; almost as long as wide (length to lateral mandible base 1.00 mm, maximum width 0.98 mm); a few setae on the dorsum; fontanelle absent. Compound eyes and ocelli absent. Antennae short, 13-segmented, moderately hairy; segment 1 the longest, broad and stout; segment 2 smaller than segment 1 and distinctly longer than segment 3, segment 3 the shortest; segments 4—12 gradually lengthening; terminal segment long and pointed, longer than the penultimate one. Clypeus divided into anteclypeus and postclypeus: anteclypeus narrow, hairless, sharply delimited from the postclypeus, anterior margin convex; postclypeus large, with several hairs, moderately arched, separated from the frons by a semicircular suture and divided into left and right halves by a longitudinal suture. Labrum subrectangular, narrowing towards the obtusely rounded apex, wider than long; labral face with several setae. Mandibles of the Microcerotermes type: left mandible with 1 apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth finger-shaped, the first marginal tooth stout and smaller than the apical tooth, the second marginal tooth small and obtuse and far from the first; right mandible likewise with 1 apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth stout with an obtuse pointed tip, the first marginal tooth equal to or slightly smaller than the apical tooth, the second marginal tooth smaller and close to the first. Pronotum weakly saddle-shaped, with a few setae. Legs short, moderately hairy, tibial spur formula 2:2:2, tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen long, hairy; cerci short, 2-segmented; styli short, 1-segmented.
